description: Author, validate, review, and evolve DESIGN.md design-system documents for coding agents, grounded in Google's design.md format and philosophy.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me create or review a DESIGN.md design-system document for my product, keeping the visual intent specific and the tokens consistent.
interface.longDescription: Create and improve DESIGN.md files that combine structured design tokens with clear visual rationale. Review token references, document hierarchy, accessibility concerns, and changes between design-system versions. Guidance follows the Google Labs design.md repository; use its CLI for actual linting, diffing, and export operations.

name: design-md-guide
